name: Market Watch Panel
summary: This is a market watch panel utility for MetaTrader 5 that displays real-time market data and symbol information on the chart. It does not execute any trades and serves purely as a visual monitoring dashboard for traders to observe multiple instruments simultaneously.
summary_zh: 这是一个MetaTrader 5的市场观察面板工具，用于在图表上实时显示市场数据和品种信息。它不执行任何交易，纯粹作为可视化监控仪表板，供交易者同时观察多个交易品种。
strategy_analysis: 此EA是一个纯工具型面板，不具备任何交易策略功能。它的核心功能是在图表上绘制一个信息面板，展示多个交易品种的实时报价、涨跌幅、点差等关键市场数据。入场条件和出场条件均不适用，因为该工具不进行任何交易操作。仓位管理和资金管理同样不适用，因为不涉及任何头寸开平。其主要价值在于帮助交易者在一个界面内快速浏览多个品种的市场状态，从而辅助手动交易决策。该面板可能包含品种切换、数据刷新、颜色自定义等用户界面功能。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a pure utility panel with no trading strategy functionality whatsoever. Its core function is to render an information panel on the chart displaying real-time quotes, price changes, spreads, and other key market data for multiple trading instruments. Entry and exit conditions are not applicable since the tool does not execute any trades. Position sizing and money management are likewise not applicable as no positions are ever opened or closed. Its primary value lies in helping traders quickly survey the market status of multiple instruments within a single interface, thereby assisting manual trading decisions. The panel likely includes features such as symbol switching, data refresh, color customization, and other user interface capabilities for enhanced monitoring convenience.

parameters.name: ShowChange
parameters.description_en: Whether to display price change percentage

pros: 一屏多品种监控，提高市场观察效率
实时数据刷新，信息获取及时
纯显示工具，无交易风险，安全可靠
可自定义面板位置和外观，用户体验友好
辅助手动交易决策，提供全面市场概览
pros_en: Multi-instrument monitoring on a single screen improves market observation efficiency
Real-time data refresh ensures timely information access
Pure display tool with no trading risk, safe and reliable
Customizable panel position and appearance for user-friendly experience
Assists manual trading decisions by providing comprehensive market overview
cons: 不产生任何自动交易信号，功能单一
可能占用图表空间，影响其他指标显示
刷新频率过高可能导致CPU负载增加
无法保存历史数据或进行回测分析
仅作为辅助工具，无法替代完整的交易策略
cons_en: Does not generate any automated trading signals, limited functionality
May occupy chart space and interfere with other indicator displays
High refresh rate may increase CPU load
Cannot save historical data or perform backtesting analysis
Serves only as an auxiliary tool, cannot replace a complete trading strategy
improvements: 增加可自定义品种列表功能，允许用户选择监控的品种
添加价格报警功能，当品种达到预设价位时发出通知
improvements_en: Add customizable symbol list feature allowing users to select which instruments to monitor
Add price alert functionality to send notifications when instruments reach preset price levels

risk_points: 纯显示工具，无交易风险
高刷新率可能导致终端性能下降
risk_points_en: Pure display tool with no trading risk
High refresh rate may cause terminal performance degradation
